story.s0.title: The In-Between
story.s0.body: The alarms fall silent. The Cupola drifts at the edge of something taller than any building ever made: the Spire. AIDA, the station AI, reports that every clock is wrong. Only the control panel still glows, six kinds of orbs blinking as if waiting for a touch.
story.s1.title: Water Zone: The Rising Tide
story.s1.body: Water rises from a place with no sea. In the surf, Thuy Tinh appears from the torn memory of a Vietnamese legend: a god demanding back what was never his. The Shadows around him are only echoes. AIDA notes: "They are not evil. They are lost."
story.s2.title: Fire Zone: The Iron Whip
story.s2.body: Fire does not rise; it falls like rain. In memory, a boy swells into a giant, an iron whip sweeping the sky. On the control panel, the glass above the screen has fogged slightly. AIDA says it is only condensation, though outside there is only vacuum.
story.s3.title: Wood Zone: The Seed
story.s3.body: A forest grows from bare rock. Every melon seed that sprouts is a promise to survive on a barren island. The Cupola trembles in a steady rhythm, like fingers tapping on a table. AIDA measures the frequency but cannot find the source.
story.s4.title: Light Zone: The Lyre
story.s4.body: Light arrives from a horizon with no sun. The melody of a lyre echoes through the void, and the Shadows around it slow as if listening. Apollo cannot remember how he came here, but he remembers the music perfectly.
story.s5.title: Dark Zone: The Watcher
story.s5.body: The night of Nyx covers everything. On the observation screen, a figure stands very far away, silent, looking toward the Cupola. When AIDA asks who it is, the figure answers: "I am keeping it from falling." Then the signal dies. None of the missing crew has been found.
story.s6.title: Heart Zone: Mending
story.s6.body: At the end of this season a colossal Shadow collapses, not defeated but spent: it was only the Spire's own reaction, like a body pushing out a foreign thing. The gods begin to remember home. In the station log there is a strange timestamp: someone opened the module door the night before the incident.

help.fight.title: Combat
help.fight.1: Press and hold an orb, then drag it across the board, diagonals included. The number on the bar under the team is the drag time left (5 seconds max). Release to end the move.
help.fight.2: Three or more orbs of the same color in a row pop; new orbs fall and can pop again as a combo chain. More combos, more damage.
help.fight.3: Orbs matching a hero's element deal damage to enemies. Heart orbs heal the whole team. Team HP is the sum of all five heroes; at 0 you lose.
help.fight.4: Element advantage: Water beats Fire, Fire beats Wood, Wood beats Water; Light and Dark counter each other. Hitting a weak element deals ×1.5, hitting a resistant one only ×0.5. On the hero cards: green arrows rising mean that hero counters the targeted enemy, red arrows falling mean the enemy counters them; no arrows means neutral. Hits show a gold ▲ "Super effective!" or a grey ▼ "Resisted".
help.fight.5: Popping a group of 4: damage ×1.5. Popping a group of 5 creates an Enhanced orb, shown as a winged gold badge.
help.fight.6: An Enhanced orb stays on the board until it pops. Each one in a popping group adds 25% damage to that group.
help.fight.7: The lightbulb button hints at a move. The pause button is in the top-right corner.
help.heroes.title: Heroes and skills
help.heroes.1: Each hero has an element, HP, attack and heal. The first hero is the leader (crown), and the leader skill is always active.
help.heroes.2: When a hero tile says "Ready", tap it to use the active skill. After use it needs to cool down, one dot per turn.
help.heroes.3: Two neighbouring heroes forming a Duo pair: when both single skills are ready, both slots glow and the Duo ✦ button lights up. Tapping a hero asks Single skill or Duo. Duo fires both skills together at ×1.5 power plus the pair's own effect, but both heroes go on cooldown.
help.heroes.4: Tap an enemy to lock the whole team's target. "Attacks in n" means n turns until it strikes.
help.heroes.5: Press and hold a hero, enemy or door to see details: stats, skills, effects, possible drops.
help.heroes.6: Active effects show as small icons with turns left: red border is harmful, green is helpful. See Effect keywords below for each one.
help.tower.title: Climbing the Tower
help.tower.1: The Tower has 6 zones, each tied to an element. Each zone has 7 stages. Clearing all 7 at one difficulty unlocks the next (Easy, Normal, Hard). Clearing all 7 on Easy also unlocks the next zone.
help.tower.2: Each stage is a climb of a few floors. Before each floor you pick a door: Monsters, Elite, Swarm, Chest, Rest, Mystery, Shrine or Shop. The last floor has fixed enemies; stage 7 has an Elite and a Boss.
help.tower.3: Every door previews its enemies and rewards. Tap a door to look, then confirm to enter.
help.tower.4: Team HP carries over between floors of the same climb. Heal with Heart orbs, Rest doors or items. A new climb starts at full HP.
help.tower.5: Relics found at Shrines, Merchants or Elites only last for that climb.
help.tower.6: If you lose you keep the items you picked up and only miss the completion reward. You can leave mid-climb; it is saved so you can resume. Higher difficulty gives bigger rewards. The first clear of a stage also gives Spirit Gems.
help.grow.title: Making heroes stronger
help.grow.1: Level up with Essence (Drop, Vial, Cauldron) or Spirit Fodder, from the hero page or the Stash. Fodder comes from Soul Summon Tickets.
help.grow.2: Skill upgrades need Offerings (dropped by enemy clan) and Gold. Each level makes the skill stronger or its cooldown shorter.
help.grow.3: Awaken to Form 2 needs Soul Shards, Rare Stones of the hero's element, and Gold. Stones drop in the zone of the same element.
help.grow.4: There is no equipment and no runes. A hero's power comes from Level, Awakening and skill level.
help.grow.5: Hero Fragments: collect 3, 4 or 5 (for 3★, 4★, 5★ heroes) to summon that exact hero. Universal Fragments: 6, 8 or 10 trade for a random hero of that star you don't own. Duplicate heroes convert to Universal Fragments automatically.
help.summon.title: Summoning and Wish
help.summon.1: Summoning costs Summon Tickets. Short on tickets you can pay Spirit Gems instead (1 ticket = 100, 10 tickets = 900). You get 1 free summon each day.
help.summon.2: Touch the summoning circle to start the ritual: the light changes color to hint the rarity (blue 3★, purple 4★, gold 5★), then each card flies out, the rarest last. From the second time on you can Skip. Guarantee: by summon 60 you are sure to get a 5★ if you haven't yet. Full odds are at the bottom of the Summon screen.
help.summon.3: Wish (button at the top of the home screen): one wheel spin per day. It can give Gold, Spirit Gems, fragments or tickets. The rarer the prize, the lower its odds; the odds table is on the screen.
help.summon.4: Spirit Gems buy tickets. Earn them from quests, achievements, wishes and first clears.
help.daily.title: Shop, Quests, Achievements
help.daily.1: The Shop refreshes daily and always has 1 free item. A red dot on its button means a gift is waiting.
help.daily.2: Quests: 5 per day, refreshed the next day. Claim each reward, and finishing all 5 gives a bonus.
help.daily.3: Achievements: long-term goals with several tiers each. Claim the reward in the Achievements tab when you reach one.
help.tips.title: Tips
help.tips.1: Before choosing a door, check the enemy element and put a hero that counters it first in the team.
help.tips.2: Low on HP? Pick a Rest door or pop Heart orbs. Don't risk an Elite without enough HP.
help.tips.3: Lock the weakest enemy first to take fewer hits.
